Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: flat full-colour paint-texture atlas for a premium custom-painted rally car.
The two attached photographs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY for the airbrush gradients, saturated enamel colour, hand-painted lettering and ornate pinstriping of Panama's diablos rojos school buses. DO NOT COPY THEIR ARTWORK OR CHARACTERS. Create completely original paint art.
HARD REQUIREMENT: NO PORTRAITS. No people, human figures, faces, masks, animals, eyes, skulls, characters, saints or celebrity imagery anywhere.
Design title: RUTA DEL SOL. Depict a spectacular tropical coastal road winding between turquoise sea, rainforest hills, a waterfall, golden sunset clouds and palms. Vivid candy turquoise, hot magenta, sun yellow, tangerine, cobalt and crisp white/black outlines. Genuine exuberant hand-airbrushed vehicle mural feel: rich soft sprayed gradients combined with sharp enamel pinstripes, shadowed sign-painter lettering, flowing scallops, ornamental flourishes, small checker borders and starbursts. Contemporary very high-end finish but PERSONALIZED street craftsmanship. NOT botanical wallpaper, engraved book art, flowers, gold-on-dark luxury motifs, or a restrained racing wrap.
EXACT FORMAT: landscape 3:2 image, precisely 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square tiles, flush grid, no white gutters, no external captions.
Top-left tile is bonnet painting: tropical coast mural and a bold spectacular sign-painted "SOL" word in the upper-middle 60% of the square, surrounded by candy-colour flourishes and outlines. Lettering readable upright in the flat image.
Top-middle tile is left side: long tropical-road airbrush mural. Original large hand-painted words "RUTA DEL SOL" in a compact central sign-painter composition at x50% y69%, mostly within the central 48% width and y58-80%. Painted scenic imagery and vivid pinstripe border fill the rest. This tile will become a wide car door/quarter mural.
Top-right tile is the complementary right-side mural, coastal road flowing the opposite way but the words "RUTA DEL SOL" remain normally readable, not mirrored.
Bottom-left tile: front-fascia decoration, swirling vivid turquoise/magenta/yellow scallops with coastal wave accents and crisp pinstripe borders, no lettering.
Bottom-middle tile: rear panel, tropical waterfall/sea sunset mural with short elegant "SOL" signwriting near y55%.
Bottom-right tile: richly decorated matching enamel ground with flowing candy gradients, geometric pinstripes and flourishes; no text, scenery or faces. This is supporting paint for pillars and fenders.
Paint every tile as flat 2D pigment artwork. No buses, car mockups, vehicle outlines, grids drawn over the art, embossed physical objects, photographed reflections, watermarks or existing logos. Avoid big blank zones. The art should look like a Panama custom bus painter personally decorated all panels of a car, without any portraiture.
